document.title: Node Hook/Tags Inspector Fields
document.purpose: Record hook and tags support in the node data model and inspector.

summary: Nodes now include a hook string and a tags list. The inspector exposes Hook and Tags fields after Title. Tags are edited through a tkinter Entry as whitespace-separated words and stored as a list of strings.

node-shape.tags: list of strings, default empty list
node-shape.normalization: Older project files that lack hook or tags load with hook as an empty string and tags as an empty list.

layout.geometry-row: Width, Height, and Angle are now compact entries in the same inspector row.
layout.buttons: Existing compact action button row remains unchanged.

save-load.save: copy_node() includes hook and tags through NODE_KEYS.
save-load.load: normalize_node() supplies defaults and accepts legacy string tags by splitting on whitespace.
